hooks.name: Guard tool calls
hooks.description: Blocks hard stops, writing SQL, secret files, personal/ and encrypted vault notes; in Kiro also blocks what other tools ask about (the user runs it): pushes, Git that loses uncommitted work, wide or outside deletes, Personal/, publishing, loaders, cloud CLIs, gh merges and deletes, HTTP writes off localhost, MCP tools that delete, trash or send, and Hostinger changes (.ai/hooks/guard.mjs).
